gate_c_2026-09-17.rule: Exact bid/ask tick replay on Gate B's top-3 finalists + control geometry. Filter to executable_r (meanR) STRICTLY > 0. Winner = argmax(R/occupied_day) among positive finalists. KILL if none positive. Applied to both Gate A survivors.

full_catalog_sweep_2026-10-14.note: Full replication of the NASDAQ/USDMXN catalog (16 ported + 20 batch-2 recalibrated + 14 phase-2), default grid + two fine geometry sweeps per edge, Gate C on the top positive geometry. Cross-asset thesis excluded per user instruction.
full_catalog_sweep_2026-10-14.status_counts_note: KILLED_GATE_A=34 (no positive net_mean_R cell in default+2 fine grids), KILLED_GATE_C=10 (a positive Gate A cell existed; exact bid/ask replay meanR<0 for all 10), FLOOR_FAIL=6 (<2000 model rows).
full_catalog_sweep_2026-10-14.parser_note: 7 of the 10 Gate C results were initially stored with meanR=None because the runner regex rejected a leading + on CI upper bounds; re-parsed from the saved raw output and corrected here. No result changed class (all meanR<0).
full_catalog_sweep_2026-10-14.gate_c_methodology_note: CORRECTED 2026-10-15: the Gate C runs in this sweep passed --cost-bps 6.01 as an EXTRA charge on top of exact Bid/Ask fills -- this was an error (double-charges the spread), NOT project procedure; all live edges were certified at extra 0. They also replayed only the top-1 cell per edge. Superseded by GATE_C_EXTRA0_RERUN_2026-10-15. Original note: Gate C exec_r = (gross_exact_bidask - signal_mid*extra_bps/1e4)/sl_dist: real bid/ask spread is already paid in gross, THEN an additional cost_bps (6.01) is subtracted. Established project procedure (same for all assets) so comparable to the live edges, but it is a second charge on top of the spread. Back-of-envelope: adding back Gate A cost_r at the same geometry puts the best (updownvolasymmetry_short) at ~+0.02R with CI spanning ~+-0.05 -- not distinguishable from zero after selection among ~15,700 geometry cells.
full_catalog_sweep_2026-10-14.final_disposition: 0 of 50 mechanisms pass Gate C on USOIL. No edge to take to PBO/Gate D. Paused per user instruction.

GATE_C_EXTRA0_RERUN_2026-10-15.procedure: Same as NASDAQ GATE_C_EXTRA0_RERUN_2026-10-14: ALL Gate-B-positive cells pooled across each edge's default+FINE1+FINE2 grids (deduped), exact Bid/Ask, extra 0, delay 0, PBO s=16 compound_velocity_stat, PASS = PBO<0.5 AND Prob[OOS<=0]<0.5, survivors -> Steps 01-09 -> Gate D.
GATE_C_EXTRA0_RERUN_2026-10-15.scope: Exactly the 10 edges with any Gate-B-positive cell (1379 unique cells total; originally only 1 cell/edge replayed). Source files of all 10 unchanged since their grids. The other 40 USOIL edges died at Gate B or row floor -- unaffected.

macdhistaccel_short.verdict: KILLED (judgment): only 1 exec-positive cell so CSCV/PBO not computable; its compound_velocity_score (locked selection metric) is NEGATIVE -- log-growth at f=0.01 loses money despite +0.0005R arithmetic mean.

updownvolasymmetry_short.verdict: KILLED_PBO (near miss: Prob[OOS<=0] passes, PBO 54.2% fails)

natrregime_short.drift_note: Trigger is direction-agnostic (short on every bar with NATR_21 rank >= 0.90; docstring claiming a down-bar condition is wrong; identical event set to natrregime_long). Results track oil direction: strongest in falling halves, -0.036 in the +33% 2026H1 rally; but ~0 in 2022H2 (oil -28%), so not pure drift.
natrregime_short.steps_01_09: ALL PASS (Step05 31/31, Step06 8/8, Step08 0 mismatches, Step09 PASS) but approved rate 97.94% at default threshold (meta-filter ~no-op)
natrregime_short.verdict: KILLED_GATE_D. Raw event has PBO-clean positive executable expectancy but the meta-model has no discriminative power. Folder kept (no-delete policy); edge.yaml stays research_in_progress; NOT promoted. Geometry lock left in source (same precedent as NASDAQ thrustcontinuation_long).

GATE_C_EXTRA0_RERUN_2026-10-15.outcome: 0 USOIL edges clear everything. 1 (natrregime_short) passed Gate C+PBO but failed Gate D. Verdicts unchanged from the double-charged sweep, but kill reasons are now correct (mostly PBO, not Gate C).
